pages.text: Buildings $(bold)never stop working from damage or manual shutdown$() — when a building is hit by monsters or explosions it only loses some blocks visually, while still operating and contributing normally. Missing blocks are filled back in via $(bold)Repair$() in the overview camera.

$(li)Open the overview camera with V, aim at the damaged building, and click $(bold)Repair$() below the info box.$(li)Clicking Repair makes wizards fill in the missing blocks per the blueprint (the warehouse must have the matching elements / materials).$(li)$(bold)Damage doesn't auto-repair$(): you must click "Repair" to trigger it.$(li)A damaged building keeps working normally even if you never repair it — only the appearance is affected.
pages.title: Repairing Buildings

pages.text: After you submit a construction site, wizards lay the building down block by block; when materials run short it pauses at "Waiting for Materials" and resumes automatically once the warehouse has them. To see which stage a building is at, aim at it in the overview camera; to open the construction UI of an empty site (not a single block placed yet), right-click it from overview.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:node_guide)Element Node$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:warehouse_guide)Warehouse & Materials$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:overview_guide)Panel & Overview$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
